findings.title: Benchmark comes from a single household, so accuracy may not generalize to other cooks, plates and phones
findings.evidence: Owner decision 2026-09-28: only the owner collects the 300 weighed meals; ADR 0002 assumed 10-20 households

findings.title: Stop hook demanded a new handoff after merges because checkouts rewrite file mtimes
findings.evidence: After fast-forwarding T-004 (note already committed in the branch), the Stop hook blocked with handoff-missing; forcing a note on main diverges from active worktree journals
findings.resolution: Committed changes are now judged by commit ancestry (a note-adding commit must contain the last change); mtimes only for uncommitted files. Regression case added to harness/hooks/selftest-hooks.mjs
